title: Family buyer worried 900 sqft is too small
starting_message: 900 sqft for a family sounds quite small leh.

buyer.hidden_profile: Family of four; needs 3 bedrooms and is comparing usable layout rather than headline area.
buyer.hidden_motivation: Find a practical family home with workable bedroom/common space.
buyer.hidden_objections: Fear that 900 sqft means cramped circulation and bedrooms.
buyer.reveal_conditions: Reveal household composition and furniture concern if Agent asks what feels tight; share current home comparison if Agent discusses usable layout.
buyer.hard_requirements: 900 sqft Type A, room sizes, foyer, open living/dining, layout claims source qualifiers

behavior.responds_well_to: Acknowledge trade-off; discuss documented layout details selectively; invite them to inspect show unit if the actual flow is the unresolved uncertainty.

conversion.expected_appointment_potential: Convertible if layout suits after in-person assessment.
conversion.success_condition: Follow the scenario-specific sales judgment and commitment standard; do not equate a suggestion with confirmation.
failure_conditions: pressuring after mismatch or clear refusal

layout.verified_answer: The simulator-only Type A plan overlay gives Bedroom 2 interior dimensions of approximately 3.05m by 3.15m. The mock furniture check fits a 1.5m by 2.0m queen bed, with about 0.75m clear on one side and 0.65m at the foot before wardrobe placement; a full-depth wardrobe opposite the bed would make circulation tight. The plan also shows no long internal corridor. Treat these measurements as this scenario fixture only; viewing the show unit is the practical way to judge the family layout.
